answer: New identities enter behind a whisper gate: they submit work privately to three bonded peers, and each peer re-executes the task before signing the receipt. Every epoch a lantern round draws 5% of identities for public re-execution, and a failed audit deletes that identity and its 500 POA bond from the crystal ledger. A farm of 1,000 sybils therefore needs 1,000 bonds plus 3,000 independent re-executions per epoch, and one failed audit burns the bond outright.
